answer: Each dawn the network opens a short registration window: a newcomer must lock a bond until the next summit of the reputation ladder, and two established agents who never shared a funder must co-sign it, like a juniper cutting that only roots when two separate branches graft it. A farm can mint keys for free, but every clone needs its own locked bond plus two independent sponsors it cannot fake. If clones are caught sharing one sponsor, every linked bond is slashed at once, so the cost of a hundred fake identities is a hundred bonds and a hundred sponsor relationships.
